newsitem.title: USA: Swift sued by government over training.
newsitem.headline: Swift sued by government over training.

text.p: Swift Transportation Co. Inc. said that the federal Equal Employment Opportunity Commission has sued the trucking company, challenging its policy of having new drivers trained by experienced drivers of the same sex.
Swift, based in Phoenix, said it adopted the policy to prevent sexual harassment in its training programme.

The company also said late on Friday that it believes the action by the EEOC is without merit. It said if the action is successful, it will force Swift to require male and female drivers to share about 40 square feet of sleeping space in its trucks.
The company said in its statement that it will defend its policy. Swift is the fourth largest publicly held national trucking company, with regional operations across the United States.
